assumptions: The ticket's 'old caption look' (--t-md) wins over DESIGN.md's --t-lg for caption h2

lessons.lesson: When a ticket says a new element must match an old look, diff the old CSS rule from git (git log -p -S) and compare it with the existing new rule before trusting an earlier attempt.
lessons.when: Retry of a CSS ticket where a previous attempt already edited the stylesheet
lessons.evidence: Attempt 1 left caption h2 at --t-lg while the old caption rule was --t-md
